A capability the engine advertises (mobile/ENGINE_DEFAULT.json, or the Swift `advertisedCapabilities` literal) requires zero swift-pending cases and zero unported tests in every family listed under it; coverage.test.js enforces that. Every family a fixture or an unported entry uses must appear under some capability, so no family can hold owed work that no gate reads. `compare` (NE-05) is the comparator's own table, not a rule of the product: it sits under EVERY capability because each one's verdicts are only as good as the Swift comparator that produced them.
